notes: The two *which*s are counted against the morphemes that could carry them: the first clause has no resumptive morpheme, so its relative is added under rule 55, while the object suffix of יְדַעְתִּים points at the antecedent and takes the second under rule 18.
*too … for* is one discontinuous rendering of the comparative מִן, headed on the relational word per rule 24; leaving *too* with the verb is the competing reading, recorded in the unit note.
